prompt: We need a full notification system for replay. Users should get notified when a replay they're watching finishes processing, when someone shares a replay with them, when there are comments on their replays, and they should be able to configure which notifications they get via email vs in-app. Also need an admin panel to manage notification templates.

assertions.text: Identifies the request as too large for a single issue and proposes splitting
Decomposes into 2-4 separate issues with clear boundaries
Each decomposed issue has its own Job Story, Promise, and Acceptance Criteria
Shows dependency relationships between the decomposed issues
Notification preferences/configuration is separated from the core notification infrastructure
Admin panel is a separate issue from user-facing notifications
Presents all issues for user confirmation before creating any
